task: KMNIST bounded single-character recognition with CoImNet CPU continuous artificial example core; no natural-page, connectome advantage or full-brain quality claim
development_data: first 1000 balanced official training samples and first 200 official test samples already used for diagnostic comparisons; never report these as blind final test

final_protocol.evaluation: 2000 balanced official test samples, per-class offset 20 excludes the 200 diagnostic samples
final_protocol.usefulness_gate: Each seed reaches at least 80% exact single-character accuracy and exceeds its untrained result; report same-data 4-nearest-neighbor comparison separately, with no required superiority claim
final_protocol.training_order: PCG(seed,37) shuffles the previous epoch permutation once per epoch; identical to the development prototype policy. Only training indices are shuffled.
final_protocol.runner: Temporary driver built from exact examples/realocr source copies with only the original main renamed; use unchanged strict LoadDataset and public tasks/ocr SDK. Select 2200 balanced test samples then discard first 200. Preserve driver source, transformation and hashes as evidence. Standard CLI verified separately.

scope: diagnose existing constant-class failure with controlled alignment and input/objective experiments
add compatible optional aligned-columns and single-character OCR input profiles; preserve old profile and saved models
prove real-data held-out performance and true new-process restore; disconnect core control
full framework validation, evidence preservation and owned temp cleanup

skeleton.SDK: RecognizerConfig optional InputProfile/CharacterWidth; Inputs returns actual neural-step inputs; aligned profile adds a zero terminal step and aligns logits/upstream; character profile uses one full-image row followed by one zero propagation row and final-row softmax; seeded encoder PCG(seed,42) scaled by sqrt(input width).
skeleton.CLI: --input-profile with empty legacy default, aligned-columns or single-character; all effective configuration and capacity saved/reported; training split only updates model
skeleton.compatibility: Default profile and existing checkpoints, constructor, tensor shapes and inference outputs unchanged; new profiles persist explicitly

resource_limit: native APFS only; project-owned caches and 21.24MB licensed source copies under runs/.tmp; no SSH and no training on SMB; no new dependencies
